informal_statement:
For a real \(\lambda\) and planar set \(F\), this is the conjunction that \(F\) is closed, bounded and measurable, \(f_\lambda\) is integrable over \(F\) and its canonical frontier measure, and
\[
\mathcal H^1(\partial F)<\infty.
\]
